info.title: Apply CRM API
info.description: Job-search CRM: organizations, positions, contacts and a graph of actions. Every operation lists the permissions it needs in `x-permissions`; operations marked with `x-mcp` are also MCP tools.

apiKey.description: Personal API key (crm_…), also accepted in the x-api-key header

unclaimed.description: No user exists yet; the first sign-up becomes instance admin

ActionStatus.description: planned → done | cancelled | no_show | rescheduled. Allowed values depend on the type: offers, rejections and notes are always done; only meetings and interviews can be no_show.

Suggestion.description: A suggested position update. Nothing is applied automatically; call updatePosition to accept it.
